DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Hyperplasia with a suspicious left adnexal mass.

The ultrasound shows a thickened endometrial stripe, which explains your bleeding. The adnexal mass requires further evaluation to rule out malignancy, so I will proceed with a biopsy of the endometrium and further characterization of the mass. Do you have a history of obesity or unopposed estrogen use?
